desc: The system closed Paper Cut, 2 of 2: the next start finds the record ending on screen with no clean exit and no crash report: '[memory] record:' lines log it (kept as memory_record_last.txt) and the note 'The system closed Paper Cut' shows over the game
log_must: ^\[memory\] the last run was closed by the system while on screen \(no clean exit, no crash report\)
^\[memory\] record: \d+ s on screen: \d+ MB in use, 4000 MB left
^\[memory\] note shown: The system closed Paper Cut: Last time, your device ended the game while you played
